$comment: Shots play in order and cross-fade. from/to = the point (0–1 of the image) the camera is centred on at the start and end of the shot; zoom = [start, end]; frames = shot length. transition = any ffmpeg xfade transition (fade, fadeblack, fadewhite, dissolve…). The source renderings are ~815px wide, so zooms are kept modest; raise them with higher-resolution originals.
